race.description: Country Music Raceday 15 August Mdn Plate
race.comment: Former Victorian IRREVERENT (7) is having her first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what she faced down south. Revved up for this with a recent trial placing and trust that Gollan has her right up to the mark. Rates the testing material against this line-up. EMPHATIQUE (5) has placed three of five over this distance range and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Has to be included in calculations. The well-related BEV'S SPECIAL (2) (half to G2 winner Every Rose) just ran into one better at Doomben on debut and will have derived a stack of benefit from that race day experience. Among the leading prospects. PEARLS IN JUNE (10) resumes here but showed enough when last in work to warrant consideration for a race like this. In the mix while fresh. SECRET SUSPICION (11) best of the rest with the 3kg claim.
